## ⚡ Improved

- **The browser extension says when it is not connected yet.** Until you enter your instance's connection phrase, the video button's menu, the toolbar popup and the settings page say so at the top, with a button that takes you to the phrase. A click on the video button leads there too, instead of a menu with no qualities in it.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The desktop app fetches ffmpeg again.** The project that publishes the ffmpeg builds moved to a new address on GitHub, and KnightLoader refused GitHub's redirect to it, so a new install had no ffmpeg and said it would come at the first start. It fetches from the new address and follows such a redirect within GitHub's API.
